introHtml: Enamel personal care items offer a durable, glossy finish that stands up to daily use in workplace restrooms or travel kits. Unlike plastic alternatives, enamel resists chipping and retains its color after repeated cleaning, making it ideal for branded mirrors, pill boxes, or grooming kits. Safety managers often choose enamel for first aid or hygiene kits because the smooth surface is easy to sanitize. Add your logo through pad printing or screen printing for a polished look that lasts.
